assessment: In this important work, the authors convincingly show that the Drosophila scavenger receptor Emp (homologous to human CD36) senses and responds to the levels of its cargo apical ECM proteins and triggers the initiation of apical endocytosis, thereby regulating tube length via controlling Crumbs and Src. This work will be of broad interest to cell and development biologists as well as cancer biologists.
